targets.name: Malapert Massif
targets.category: Artemis III candidate region (lunar south pole)
targets.description: Rugged highland massif near the lunar south pole. Analog needs: steep, rough, bare, bright anorthositic-like ground with no hydrated minerals or vegetation.

targets.name: Mons Mouton Plateau
targets.category: Artemis III candidate region (lunar south pole)
targets.description: Broad, relatively flat plateau top near the south pole: low slopes for landing and construction, bare regolith.

targets.name: Jezero Crater
targets.description: Ancient lake basin with a river delta; olivine-rich floor, clays and carbonates along the delta and margin.
targets.notes: Minerals from CRISM HRL000040FF (220,978 valid pixels; share of pixels above config/crism_groups.yaml thresholds)

targets.name: Gale Crater (Mount Sharp lower layers)
targets.description: Layered sedimentary mound: clay-bearing unit grading upward into sulfate-bearing layers, hematite ridge, moderate slopes.

targets.name: Arcadia Planitia
targets.category: Candidate human landing region (shallow ground ice)
targets.description: Very flat, smooth mid-latitude plains with near-surface ice: ideal for landing and construction. Earth analogs should be flat, smooth, cold and bare.

targets.name: Meridiani Planum
targets.description: Flat plains of sulfate-rich sandstone covered by hematite "blueberry" concretions.

elev_mean.label: Elevation
elev_mean.description: Mean elevation (display only; absolute elevation is not comparable across bodies)

slope_mean.label: Mean slope
slope_mean.description: Mean slope within the cell, from a ~30 m DEM

slope_p75.label: Steep slope (p75)
slope_p75.description: 75th percentile of slope within the cell

roughness.label: Roughness
roughness.description: Standard deviation of elevation within the cell

relief.label: Local relief
relief.description: Max minus min elevation within the cell

gentle_slope_frac.label: Gentle ground (0-15 deg)
gentle_slope_frac.description: Share of the cell's land with a slope of 15 deg or less (water and ocean excluded): ground you can land, drive and build on

min_mafic.label: Mafic minerals
min_mafic.description: Olivine / pyroxene: basalt plains, lava fields

ndvi.label: NDVI
ndvi.description: Vegetation index; Moon and Mars are ~0

water_fraction.label: Water
water_fraction.description: Share of open water; cells that are mostly water are not scored

clay_index.label: Clay index (HLS)
clay_index.description: SWIR1/SWIR2 band ratio: higher where clays and micas absorb near 2.2 um. Available everywhere, unlike EMIT

ferric_index.label: Ferric iron index (HLS)
ferric_index.description: Red/blue band ratio: higher on reddish, iron-oxide-rich ground. Available everywhere

tmin_k.label: Lowest temperature
tmin_k.description: Lowest daily minimum air temperature (2 m) over the year

tday_range_k.label: Daily temperature range
tday_range_k.description: Mean day-night range of air temperature (2 m)

tyear_range_k.label: Yearly temperature range
tyear_range_k.description: Warmest minus coldest monthly mean air temperature

sun_elev_deg.label: Noon sun elevation
sun_elev_deg.description: Mean noon sun elevation over the year (from latitude)

hydrogen_or_soilmoist.label: Soil moisture
hydrogen_or_soilmoist.description: Mean soil moisture index at 5 cm (Earth's stand-in for Moon/Mars hydrogen)

ice_flag.label: Ice or frozen ground
ice_flag.description: 1 if snow or frozen ground on at least 15 days a year

dust_aod.label: Dust
dust_aod.description: Mean dust aerosol optical depth at 550 nm

wind_ms.label: Wind speed
wind_ms.description: Mean daily wind speed at 10 m
